reason: A proposes a clear, controllable microstructural intervention and a direct precipitate-strengthening mechanism that can be tested against an as-deposited baseline, although Cu-precipitate stability and supporting evidence remain weaknesses. B relies on a physically dubious climb-induced twinning mechanism at high temperature and misextends evidence about twinning in a nickel substrate at 300 K to twinning within the HEA coating during hot sliding.
